**Verified clean (all 10 assigned files fully read):** mounted/`context.mounted` guards preserved after the same async gaps in `session_chat_sheet`, `js_app_view`, `dynamic_widget_graduation`, `dynamic_widget_tile`, and `apps_grid`; dispose/cancel ordering intact in `app_tile_host` (refresh timer → debounce → engine dispose) and `session_chat_sheet`; catch/rethrow semantics preserved (`_startEngine` dispose+rethrow, `_treeView` reportHostError+rethrow); state-mutation order preserved in `apps_store`'s cache gate, prune, and install-verify paths; `widget_payload_validator`'s pure-function split keeps stage ordering and both catch arms.

One limitation noted for the parent: no shell tool was available, so verification was done by full-file reading of the new code rather than `git diff` — both findings are nonetheless grounded in code read in full with surrounding context.
